question_text: A nonempty list labels contains "inside" or "outside". A supplied estimation rule is 4 times the number of "inside" entries divided by the total entries. Construct estimate(labels) in Python using a loop to return that value.
adaptation_rationale: Changes spreadsheet formula to Python traversal/selection with mathematical rule supplied, so no Monte Carlo theory is required.
partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
